# iNNfo Technical Documentation
> Specifications, core engine packages, visual modeler, and agent MCP integration.

## Documentation Index

- [Home](README): Documentation entry point and overview.
- [innfo-editor](innfo-editor): Interactive browser-based graphical editor for iNNfo models.
- [innfo-core](innfo-core): Core parser, resolver, validator, and AST engine.
- [innfo-mcp](innfo-mcp): Model Context Protocol server exposing iNNfo capabilities to AI agents.
- [OpenCode Agent](opencode-innfo-agent): Integration guide for OpenCode and Antigravity agent workflows.
- [Ecosystem](ecosystem): Holistic view of cogNNitive ecosystem layers (iNNfo, actioNN, eNNvironment).
- [Specifications](specifications): Formal specification of the iNNfo format and meta-template layers.
- [OKF Compatibility](ecosystem?id=open-knowledge-format-compatibility): Alignment and compatibility with the Open Knowledge Format standard.
- [Discipline Overlaps](discipline-overlaps): How cogNNitive overlaps with established disciplines — Model-Driven Engineering, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Architecture, Ontology Engineering, Docs as Code, and Personal Knowledge Management.
- [Usage](usage): Practical workflow examples and CLI usage.
- [Relationships & Connections](relationships): Graph relationships, bidirectional edges, and matrices in iNNfo.
- [Sources, Citations & Lineage](citations-provenance): How the pipeline tracks where knowledge comes from, with three terms — Source, Citation, Lineage.
- [Lifecycle Walkthrough (Case Study)](lifecycle-walkthrough): End-to-end walkthrough of the 3-phase knowledge lifecycle using the Ghostbusters Inc. sample workspace.
- [Tags & Open Taxonomy](tags-and-taxonomy): Cross-cutting categorization, centralized workspace taxonomies, and multi-dimensional view filtering.
- [Collaboration with Git](collaboration-git): Gated workspace-to-Git review workflow with private defaults, branch-per-change PR gates, version map, and offline backup.
- [Offline Consoles](offline-consoles): How generated consoles boot offline from file:// via static script tags and a vendored UMD bundle.
- [Console Needs & Visuals](console-needs-and-visuals): Capability needs and template-driven concept color/icon in generated consoles.
- [Validator Behavior](validator-behavior): Deterministic validation, differential baseline_path output, version inference, and workspace-first resolution.
